publisher: Minnesota Secretary of State, Business Services
reassessment_reason: The current full Business Bulk Data guide has moved to a new media URL and publishes stronger identity/address contracts. These do not remove the separate Active Business Data product's unresolved lifecycle and controlling-license gates.

access.bulk: Active Business Data provides names and primary addresses once or weekly. Full Business Bulk Data is a distinct active/inactive product with master, history and name/address records.
access.api: No supported unattended MBLS bulk download API was established; guides describe portal delivery.
access.search: Interactive filing search is separate from both downloadable products.
access.fees: Active Business Data costs $30 once or $30 each week. Full bulk offers a request path for eligible noncommercial users and a separate commercial request/license process; this project has not claimed eligibility.

fields.summary: Active guide publishes 16 columns with File Number plus Business Filing Type as composite key; filing dates may be partial and primary party names may be individuals. Full bulk separately guarantees static non-recycled Master ID across record types, publishes party/address domains and separate postal extension. Its schema must not be attributed to Active Business Data.

active_status_semantics: Active output reflects filing status when generated, not proof of operation. A disappeared Active row cannot be treated as a documented closure event. Foreign nonprofits lack annual-renewal dates under the Active guide.
statewide_completeness: The landing page and Active guide differ on Housing Cooperative inclusion. Full bulk includes name reservations and trademarks, which require separate classification; neither product is a census of operating sites.
address_zip: Active output provides ZIP and extension separately and identifies a primary business address without a full published value domain. Full bulk separately distinguishes principal, registered-office, mailing, home and agent address roles; geocoding must preserve those distinctions.
automation_terms_fees: Account/order prerequisites remain. Full bulk guide describes monthly creation and Transaction History delivery within ten days; it does not authorize portal automation. Active weekly ordering does not establish unattended extraction rights.
redistribution: The full-bulk license allows customer access in normal business but restricts substantial bulk resale/repackaging and sublicensing, and excludes updates absent a separate agreement. Which license governs Active Business Data remains unresolved; the full-bulk grant cannot be transferred by inference.
temporal_refresh: Active filenames identify run date; full bulk has export dates, monthly creation and complete related-record sets for supplied businesses. Neither establishes a verified Active deletion/replay/checksum contract or current control totals.

citations.evidence: Distinct Active and full-bulk products, current guide link, charges and order prerequisites.
Active layout, composite identity, partial dates, party fields, ZIP extension and renewal exception.
Current full-bulk guide Rev08012025: permanent Master ID, monthly creation, record types, address roles and delivery. Documentation examples only, no source dataset acquired.
Conditional commercial grant, substantial bulk resale/repackaging limit and separate update agreement.

strongest_next_action: Narrow Active Business Data review to its controlling license, composite-key lifecycle, address-value domain, Housing Cooperative scope, replacement/deletion/replay semantics and supported delivery. Treat the separately documented full-bulk Master ID and address dictionary as an alternative product contract, not a resolved Active gate. No account, order, payment, terms, contact, download, connector implementation or production admission is authorized.
